dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Huh, so there's an exam for that too...

dialogues.speaker: Granna
dialogues.text: Of course there is! Or do you think they let just anyone in?

dialogues.speaker: Granna
dialogues.text: It's precisely because they're so strict that passing is considered impressive. Hmph, I've gotta grab this chance to ask Sedile everything!

dialogues.speaker: Granna
dialogues.text: And once I've made it, I'm so gonna show off to Virda!
